verses.en: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
verses.pt: Então José se lançou sobre o rosto de seu pai, chorou sobre ele e o beijou.
verses.en_web: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph put his head down on his father's face, weeping and kissing him.

verses.en: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.pt: E José ordenou a seus servos, os médicos, que embalsamassem a seu pai; e os médicos embalsamaram a Israel.
verses.en_web: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph gave orders to his servants who had the necessary knowledge, to make his father's body ready, folding it in linen with spices, and they did so.

verses.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
verses.pt: Cumpriram-se-lhe quarenta dias, porque assim se cumprem os dias de embalsamação; e os egípcios o choraram setenta dias.
verses.en_web: Forty days were fulfilled for him, for that is how many the days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for him for seventy days.
verses.en_bbe: And the forty days needed for making the body ready went by: and there was weeping for him among the Egyptians for seventy days.

verses.en: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.pt: Passados, pois, os dias de seu choro, disse José à casa de Faraó: Se agora tenho achado graça aos vossos olhos, rogo-vos que faleis aos ouvidos de Faraó, dizendo:
verses.en_web: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And when the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph said to the servants of Pharaoh, If now you have love for me, say these words to Pharaoh:

verses.en: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
verses.pt: Meu pai me fez jurar, dizendo: Eis que eu morro; em meu sepulcro, que cavei para mim na terra de Canaã, ali me sepultarás. Agora, pois, deixa-me subir, peço-te, e sepultar meu pai; então voltarei.
verses.en_web: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”
verses.en_bbe: My father made me take an oath, saying, When I am dead, put me to rest in the place I have made ready for myself in the land of Canaan. So now let me go and put my father in his last resting-place, and I will come back again.

verses.en: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
verses.pt: Respondeu Faraó: Sobe, e sepulta teu pai, como ele te fez jurar.
verses.en_web: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”
verses.en_bbe: And Pharaoh said, Go up and put your father to rest, as you gave your oath to him.

verses.en: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.pt: Subiu, pois, José para sepultar a seu pai; e com ele subiram todos os servos de Faraó, os anciãos da sua casa, e todos os anciãos da terra do Egito,
verses.en_web: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.en_bbe: So Joseph went up to put his father in his last resting-place; and with him went all the servants of Pharaoh, and the chief men of his house and all the chiefs of the land of Egypt,

verses.en: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.pt: como também toda a casa de José, e seus irmãos, e a casa de seu pai; somente deixaram na terra de Gósen os seus pequeninos, os seus rebanhos e o seu gado.
verses.en_web: All the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.en_bbe: And all the family of Joseph, and his brothers and his father's people: only their little ones and their flocks and herds they did not take with them from the land of Goshen.

verses.en: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
verses.pt: E subiram com ele tanto carros como gente a cavalo; de modo que o concurso foi mui grande.
verses.en_web: There went up with him both chariots and horsemen. It was a very great company.
verses.en_bbe: And carriages went up with him and horsemen, a great army.

verses.en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
verses.pt: Chegando eles à eira de Atade, que está além do Jordão, fizeram ali um grande e forte pranto; assim fez José por seu pai um grande pranto por sete dias.
verses.en_web: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.
verses.en_bbe: And they came to the grain-floor of Atad on the other side of Jordan, and there they gave the last honours to Jacob, with great and bitter sorrow, weeping for their father for seven days.

verses.en: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
verses.pt: Os moradores da terra, os cananeus, vendo o pranto na eira de Atade, disseram: Grande pranto é este dos egípcios; pelo que o lugar foi chamado Abel-Mizraim, o qual está além do Jordão.
verses.en_web: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
verses.en_bbe: And when the people of the land, the people of Canaan, at the grain-floor of Atad, saw their grief, they said, Great is the grief of the Egyptians: so the place was named Abel-mizraim, on the other side of Jordan.

verses.en: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
verses.pt: Assim os filhos de Jacó lhe fizeram como ele lhes ordenara;
verses.en_web: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,
verses.en_bbe: So his sons did as he had given them orders to do:

verses.en: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
verses.pt: pois o levaram para a terra de Canaã, e o sepultaram na cova do campo de Macpela, que Abraão tinha comprado com o campo, como propriedade de sepultura, a Efrom, o heteu, em frente de Manre.
verses.en_web: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.
verses.en_bbe: For they took him into the land of Canaan and put him to rest in the hollow rock in the field of Machpelah, which Abraham got with the field, for a resting-place, from Ephron the Hittite at Mamre.

verses.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
verses.pt: Depois de haver sepultado seu pai, José voltou para o Egito, ele, seus irmãos, e todos os que com ele haviam subido para sepultar seu pai.
verses.en_web: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
verses.en_bbe: And when his father had been put to rest, Joseph and his brothers and all who had gone with him, went back to Egypt.

verses.en: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
verses.pt: Vendo os irmãos de José que seu pai estava morto, disseram: Porventura José nos odiará e nos retribuirá todo o mal que lhe fizemos.
verses.en_web: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”
verses.en_bbe: Now after the death of their father, Joseph's brothers said to themselves, It may be that Joseph's heart will be turned against us, and he will give us punishment for all the evil which we did to him.

verses.en: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
verses.pt: Então mandaram dizer a José: Teu pai, antes da sua morte, nos ordenou:
verses.en_web: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,
verses.en_bbe: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, Your father, before his death, gave us orders, saying,

verses.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
verses.pt: Assim direis a José: Perdoa a transgressão de teus irmãos, e o seu pecado, porque te fizeram mal. Agora, pois, rogamos-te que perdoes a transgressão dos servos do Deus de teu pai. E José chorou quando eles lhe falavam.
verses.en_web: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
verses.en_bbe: You are to say to Joseph, Let the wrongdoing of your brothers be overlooked, and the evil they did to you: now, if it is your pleasure, let the sin of the servants of your father's God have forgiveness. And at these words, Joseph was overcome with weeping.

verses.en: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
verses.pt: Depois vieram também seus irmãos, prostraram-se diante dele e disseram: Eis que nós somos teus servos.
verses.en_web: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”
verses.en_bbe: Then his brothers went, and falling at his feet, said, Truly, we are your servants.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes José: Não temais; acaso estou eu em lugar de Deus?
verses.en_web: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph said, Have no fear: am I in the place of God?

verses.en: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
verses.pt: Vós, na verdade, intentastes o mal contra mim; Deus, porém, o intentou para o bem, para fazer o que se vê neste dia, isto é, conservar muita gente com vida.
verses.en_web: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is today, to save many people alive.
verses.en_bbe: As for you, it was in your mind to do me evil, but God has given a happy outcome, the salvation of numbers of people, as you see today.

verses.en: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, não temais; eu vos sustentarei, a vós e a vossos filhinhos. Assim ele os consolou, e lhes falou ao coração.
verses.en_web: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will nourish you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.
verses.en_bbe: So now, have no fear: for I will take care of you and your little ones. So he gave them comfort with kind words.

verses.en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
verses.pt: José, pois, habitou no Egito, ele e a casa de seu pai; e viveu cento e dez anos.
verses.en_web: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
verses.en_bbe: Now Joseph and all his father's family went on living in Egypt: and the years of Joseph's life were a hundred and ten.

verses.en: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.
verses.pt: E viu José os filhos de Efraim, da terceira geração; também os filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, nasceram sobre os joelhos de José.
verses.en_web: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: and the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, came to birth on Joseph's knees.

verses.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.pt: Depois disse José a seus irmãos: Eu morro; mas Deus certamente vos visitará, e vos fará subir desta terra para a terra que jurou a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó.
verses.en_web: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph said to his brothers, The time of my death has come; but God will keep you in mind and take you out of this land into the land which he gave by his oath to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob.

verses.en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
verses.pt: E José fez jurar os filhos de Israel, dizendo: Certamente Deus vos visitará, e fareis transportar daqui os meus ossos.
verses.en_web: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph made the children of Israel take an oath, saying, God will certainly give effect to his word, and you are to take my bones away from here.

verses.en: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.pt: Assim morreu José, tendo cento e dez anos de idade; e o embalsamaram e o puseram num caixão no Egito.
verses.en_web: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: So Joseph came to his death, being a hundred and ten years old: and they made his body ready, and he was put in a chest in Egypt.
